name: codex-subagent-router
description: Choose native subagent models with Jev and declarative task profiles.

interface.shortDescription: Route unpinned subagents through configurable Jev choices.
interface.longDescription: A native PreToolUse hook reads task profiles from CODEX_HOME/subagent-router and asks Jev to choose model and effort. Explicit settings remain authoritative.
defaultPrompt: Delegate this task using the configured subagent routing profiles.
